\par\smallskip\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Predicted liberalism (0--10) as a function of the overall populism score for a left-wing manifesto (ideology score $(R-L)/(R+L)$ at its 10th percentile, $-$0.73) and a right-wing manifesto (90th percentile, 0.45), from column (5) of Tables 4--8 (populism, ideology and their interaction; country and year fixed effects held at their sample average; each outcome on its own sample, N between 2,999 and 3,192). Populism runs from its 1st to its 99th percentile (1.16 to 8.67); the rug marks the observed populism scores. Shaded bands: 95 percent confidence intervals from standard errors clustered by party (CMP party code), critical value of the $t$ distribution with the number of party clusters minus one degrees of freedom.\end{minipage}
